standard_prerequisites.name: Pullback of a fibred category
standard_prerequisites.use: Provides fibredness of u^pS and the strong-cartesian characterization used to identify fibre categories and pullback functors.

core_obligations: Transfer fibredness and the strong-cartesian characterization from the cited lemma.
Identify fibre categories (u^pS)_U = S_U and the pullback functors a^*(U', y') = (U, u(a)^* y').
Continuity of u maps the covering U to a covering V of D and preserves the fibre products, so descent data for u^pS relative to U are identical to descent data for S relative to V.
Conclude effective descent for u^pS from that of S.
proof_roadmap: Identify fibres and pullbacks, transfer descent data across the continuous functor, and inherit effective descent.
difficulty_reason: One identification thread (fibres, pullbacks, descent data) followed by a direct inheritance of effectiveness; no construction beyond the identification.
